judge.rationale: The candidate's implementation is completely sound and satisfies every acceptance criterion, even adhering more literally than the reference to the ticket's request for a two-tool-round (three-provider-call) test, an unambiguous type (`TotalUsageMetadata`), and a recorded rationale for rejecting the per-round breakdown shape. Both the candidate and reference rename the hook parameter to `totalUsage`, replace `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` with a summing helper, and update `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. Minor structural differences from the reference include placing `sumUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` rather than inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, exporting the `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias from `src/types/ai.ts`, and adding tests in a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. The candidate also omitted the two new bullet points in the tool-loop prose section of `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` that the reference added.
